stories.title: Borsa: Milano chiude in calo, Ftse Mib -1,6%

en.title: Stock Exchange: Milan closes lower, Ftse Mib -1.6%
en.summary: The Milan stock exchange declined 1.6 percent, with Prysmian, ST, Tenaris, and Saipem among the worst performers, while Campari gained.

stories.title: Trump, 'Ucraina e Russia hanno accettato di non colpire obiettivi energetici'

en.title: Trump: 'Ukraine and Russia have agreed not to strike energy targets'
en.summary: Trump stated that Ukraine and Russia accepted an agreement to avoid targeting energy infrastructure, attributing rising gasoline prices to the conflict rather than Iran.

stories.title: Crolla un albero in piazza Risorgimento a Milano: feriti tre passanti, uno è grave. «Segnalato più volte, eravamo terrorizzati»

en.title: Tree falls in Piazza Risorgimento in Milan: three pedestrians injured, one seriously. 'Reported multiple times, we were terrified'
en.summary: A tree collapsed in a Milan square, injuring three pedestrians including one seriously, with residents reporting they had previously flagged concerns about the tree.

stories.title: Trump: contro IA c'è cospirazione. Cina: l'appello dei big dell'IA a rallentare è allarmismo

en.title: Trump: conspiracy against AI. China: tech leaders' call to slow AI is alarmism
en.summary: Trump accused others of conspiring against artificial intelligence, while China's government dismissed calls from technology leaders to slow AI development as alarmist, urging faster safety controls instead.

stories.title: L’arrivo insieme e i banchi vicini: il ritorno a scuola dei ragazzi del Virgilio feriti a Crans

en.title: Together again and sitting nearby: return to school for injured Virgilio students
en.summary: Four severely burned students from the Constellation incident have returned to their classroom after months of hospitalization. The students expressed joy at reuniting with their classmates.

stories.title: Mattarella: da nuove tecnologie rischi per centralità dell'uomo e aumento disparità

en.title: Mattarella: new technologies pose risks to human centrality and increase inequality
en.summary: Italy's President warned in a message to the Pope that while new technologies offer unprecedented possibilities, they risk undermining human dignity and widening disparities.

stories.title: Cardiff, storica alleanza indipendentista: Scozia, Galles e Irlanda del Nord sfidano Westminster

en.title: Cardiff, historic independence alliance: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland challenge Westminster
en.summary: Three UK nations led by independence-minded leaders coordinated a direct political challenge to Westminster. The agreement, though lacking immediate legal force, signals a potential constitutional transformation.

stories.title: Zverev vince gli US Open ma non se ne accorge fino a quando non legge il risultato sul tabellone

en.title: Zverev wins US Open but doesn't realize it until reading the scoreboard
en.summary: German tennis player Alexander Zverev defeated American Ben Shelton at the US Open in straight sets to claim his second Grand Slam title, unaware of victory until checking the display.

stories.title: Castellammare di Stabia, sequestrata e violentata per ore ragazza conosciuta sui social

en.title: Young woman sequestered and assaulted for hours after meeting man on social media in Castellammare di Stabia
en.summary: A young adult met a 26-year-old man through social media who lured her to an isolated cellar under false pretenses and subjected her to hours of violence.

stories.title: Crolla un albero in piazza Risorgimento a Milano: tre feriti

en.title: Tree collapses in Piazza Risorgimento in Milan: three injured
en.summary: A large tree branch fell unexpectedly in a Milan square, injuring three people. Two were transported to hospital in moderate condition while the third sustained more serious injuries.

stories.title: Trump attizza il fuoco dell’indipendenza: vertice contro Londra di Galles, Irlanda del Nord, Scozia

en.title: Trump stokes independence fire: summit against London with Wales, Northern Ireland, Scotland
en.summary: The U.S. president is pushing for separation from the United Kingdom. Leaders of Wales, Northern Ireland, and Scotland are calling for referendums and European Union membership.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia. Trump: “Kiev e Mosca hanno accettato stop dei raid sulle raffinerie”

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War - Trump: "Kyiv and Moscow have accepted halt to refinery raids"
en.summary: A British soldier died in a traffic accident in Ukraine. Multiple officials commented on ongoing conflict, with Russia stating it will continue operations across Ukrainian territory and the Kremlin expressing support for Trump's appeal to halt refinery attacks.

stories.title: Trasporti, flotte in crescita, i cinesi pronti a crescere sul mercato Ue

en.title: Transport, fleets growing, Chinese ready to expand in EU market
en.summary: A Bain & Company study of 500 transport operators found that 60% are willing to invest in new vehicles, with Italy reaching 70% and one-third considering electric vehicles.

stories.title: Nel secondo trimestre record di presenze dall’estero

en.title: Record foreign presences in second quarter
en.summary: Guest presences at accommodations increased in the second quarter while arrivals declined slightly, according to Istat data showing nearly 47 million arrivals.

stories.title: Crescono i consumi del gelato italiano e il Sigep di Rimini raddoppia i buyer

en.title: Italian gelato consumption grows and Sigep in Rimini doubles buyers
en.summary: Italian food products including gelato, bread, pizza, and coffee are expanding internationally, with these topics central to this year's Sigep trade show in Rimini.

stories.title: Ex Ilva, sciopero di 24 ore e blocco delle strade

en.title: Ex Ilva, 24-hour strike and road blockade
en.summary: Workers at the Taranto facility are protesting over potential layoffs affecting 2,500 employees, with a meeting scheduled at the Prime Minister's office.

stories.title: Progetti speciali e nuove giostre, Zamperla punta ai 130 milioni di fatturato

en.title: Special projects and new rides, Zamperla targets 130 million revenue
en.summary: The multinational company celebrates 60 years and introduced a new attraction called Hypnosiz, with ongoing work for Disney and Universal as well as multi-year contracts.
